name: Send automatic WhatsApp text replies with 360dialog

parameters.content:
## Send automatic WhatsApp text replies with 360dialog

### Who's it for
Anyone running WhatsApp on the [360dialog](https://www.360dialog.com/) Messaging API who wants to reply automatically to every incoming message — support inboxes, lead capture, or as a starting point for a WhatsApp chatbot.

### How it works
1. **Message Received** fires whenever a WhatsApp user sends a message to your 360dialog number.
2. **Send Text Message** replies to that user with the text “Hey from n8n, by 360dialog”.

The reply is addressed to the sender's **Business-Scoped User ID** (`fromUserId`), which is always present in the trigger output — even when the user hides their phone number behind a WhatsApp username. The trigger also filters out outbound echoes and duplicate webhook deliveries, so the workflow never replies to itself.

### How to set up
1. Install the community node package `@pmartino/n8n-nodes-360dialog` (Settings → Community Nodes).
2. Create a **360dialog API** credential with the API key from your [360dialog Hub](https://hub.360dialog.com/) and select it on both nodes.
3. Activate the workflow — the trigger registers the webhook with 360dialog automatically.
4. Send a WhatsApp message to your business number and watch the reply arrive.

### Requirements
- A 360dialog Messaging API account with an API key
- The `@pmartino/n8n-nodes-360dialog` community node package

### Good to know
360dialog delivers events to a single webhook URL per number. Activating this workflow points that webhook at n8n; the previous URL is restored when the workflow is deactivated.

### How to customize
- Change the reply text in **Send Text Message**, or switch the operation to send media or an approved template message.
- Add an AI Agent or Switch node between the two steps to route or generate replies based on `{{ $json.text }}`.

### 1. Listen for incoming messages
Fires on every inbound WhatsApp message and outputs a flat item with `fromUserId` (the sender's Business-Scoped User ID), `text`, `contactName` and more.

### 2. Reply to the sender
Sends “Hey from n8n, by 360dialog” back to the sender, using the `fromUserId` from the trigger as the recipient — this works even when the sender hides their phone number.
